_comment: Model bindings and role assignments for the two lanes (01-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE-v2 §7.6, D16). A binding's residency is recorded as an actual region only when a published source for that value is cited on the binding itself (residency_source); otherwise it is "unknown" (residency_note says why). Review R42: an earlier version of this file asserted the four Lab bindings' residencies (DeepSeek "cn", NIM "us", Moonshot "cn", HF router "us") from the task's own instructions, with no cited vendor-published source — exactly the unguessed claim this _comment now promises not to repeat, so they are "unknown" until one is cited. azure-openai-eu is "eu" by definition (it names an EU data-zone deployment), model ids [VERIFY] until the W5 bake-off (03-EVIDENCE-v2 §8, E-L1) picks one. gateway/lanes.py is what enforces this file; see its module docstring for the guard (ruling R35b: environment, not data class); tests/test_gw_lanes.py's TestResidencyIsSourced pins that no Lab binding asserts a residency without a residency_source.
